_comment: Each animal owns a family of related games from skills.json, listed in 'skills', and asks for one of them each time; its thought bubble shows that game's 'icon'. Three animals are offered at a time. A game belongs to one animal only. 'id' is also the name of its picture. 'sound' is the noise it makes when tapped: one of the names in src/systems/sfx.js. Families so far, for placing new games: hen and owl do numbers; cow and rabbit letters and sounds; mouse and sheep shapes and colours; pig directions and sizes; cat matching; dog patterns; horse sorting and thinking; duck listening.
